frame: Origin midway between the lenses; x right, height up (0 = rolling-ball center with the provisional calibration), z = perpendicular distance from the camera plane; range = straight-line distance from the midpoint

calibration.notes: Eye order, offsets, horizon and camera height refit from a rolled ball (tools/calibrate_stereo.py roll); focal length and baseline kept from the previous calibration. Assumes parallel-ish cameras and no lens distortion; a checkerboard calibration is more accurate.
